num_customers: <int> Number of customers to be served by the supplier.
num_periods: <int> Number of discrete time periods in the planning horizon.
num_vehicles: <int> Number of homogeneous vehicles available for deliveries each period.
vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum total quantity that can be loaded onto a single vehicle for one route.

depot.initial_inventory: <int> Quantity of commodity on hand at the supplier at the start of the planning horizon.
depot.max_inventory: <int> Maximum quantity of commodity the supplier can store at any time.
depot.production_per_period: <int> Quantity of commodity produced at the supplier in each period.
depot.holding_cost: <float> Per-unit cost charged on the supplier's end-of-period inventory.

customers.initial_inventory: <int> Quantity of commodity on hand at the customer at the start of the planning horizon.
customers.max_inventory: <int> Maximum quantity of commodity the customer can store at any time.
customers.min_inventory: <int> Minimum quantity of commodity the customer must hold at the end of any period.
customers.demand_per_period: <int> Quantity of commodity consumed by the customer in each period.
customers.holding_cost: <float> Per-unit cost charged on the customer's end-of-period inventory.

distance_matrix: <list[list[int]], shape [num_customers+1][num_customers+1]> Symmetric travel cost between each pair of locations, where row and column 0 is the supplier and rows/columns 1 through num_customers are customers.
